criteria.name: Text Type
criteria.feedback: Your essay demonstrates a clear and effective argumentative structure, with a strong introduction, well-organized body paragraphs, and a concise conclusion, making your writing easy to follow and fully meeting expectations for this task.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.feedback: Your essay clearly identifies a specific, well-supported improvement to city safety, provides strong examples and reasoning relevant to your age group, and thoroughly considers both the immediate and long-term benefits—exceeding the content expectations for this assignment.

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.feedback: Your proposed improvements are realistic and thoughtfully justified with clear, relevant examples, and you effectively explain both immediate and long-term benefits for people your age, demonstrating excellent accuracy and logical consistency.
